'''November 2000 Roanoke tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Star City, Roanoke, VA on 5 November 2000. [[Steven Turner]] won it. It is known from Gordon Marx's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1438">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-08-gordons-roanoke-tr-11-5-00d1438/ gordons-roanoke-tr-11-5-00], DeckTech (Gordon "Tallus" Marx, 8 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-08-gordons-roanoke-tr-11-5-00d1438/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Star City, Roanoke, VA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steven Turner]]
